notesEn.CAN: Statistics Canada: average daily adult custody in provincial/territorial (including remand) and federal institutions over the fiscal year (April 2023 to March 2024); adults only, years with a jurisdiction missing are left out. ÷ UN WPP mid-year population. notesEn.AUS: Australian Bureau of Statistics, Prisoners in Australia: persons in adult custody on 30 June (including unsentenced), excluding youth detention; ÷ UN WPP mid-year population (the ABS rate is per 100,000 adults, so it is higher). 46,998 persons in 2025
notesEn.JPN: Ministry of Justice of Japan, White Paper on Crime (correctional statistics): persons held in penal institutions (prisons and detention houses) on 31 December, including unconvicted defendants and suspects, excluding juvenile training schools and immigration detention; ÷ UN WPP mid-year population. 40,544 persons at the end of 2024
